On Fri, 2018-11-02 at 09:29 +0300, endale alemayehu wrote:
> After I fitted the model with INLA, I checked the model fit with CPO
> and PIT. However, the graph of those methods was not seems uniform
> distribution. Thus, this is kindly to ask you on how to improve to
> have uniform distribution of those techniques. Thank you very much.
>

The cpo graph should not be uniform, but PIT we aim for some
uniformity. This is about the difference between the observations and
the predictive distributions (without that data point). For discrete
responses, then these plots are just 'suggestive', like for Poisson
with few counts, I would not trust them to much, while I would for
Poisson with high counts.

There is no generic approach to improve the PIT histogram, beyond
trying to improved the model. I would not be to obsessed by it, though.
The important thing, is that the PIT histogram is not to bad.

H
